paite: Kuapeuh salh a om nak a, genhak teitei hihdamna om lou in thakhat in akise ding hi.
english: He who is often rebuked and stiffens his neck will be destroyed suddenly, with no remedy.

paite: Midiktatte apun chiang un, mite akipak uh; himahleh migilou in vaihawmna apuak chiang in, mite amau uh.
english: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; but when the wicked rule, the people groan.

paite: Kuapeuh pilna it in apa akipaksak a; himahleh kuapeuh kizuakte kithuahpih in asum amawk zatbei hi.
english: Whoever loves wisdom brings joy to his father; but a companion of prostitutes squanders his wealth.

paite: Kumpipa'n vaihawmna in gam ahihkip a; himahleh kuapeuh thilpiak phut teitei in ahihsia hi.
english: The king by justice makes the land stable, but he who takes bribes tears it down.

paite: Mi invengte maitangphat in kalsuante a ding in len azaksak hi.
english: A man who flatters his neighbor spreads a net for his feet.

paite: Mihoih lou tatlekna ah thang a-om; himahleh midiktat in la asa a, akipak hi.
english: An evil man is snared by his sin, but the righteous can sing and be glad.

paite: Midiktat in migenthei thu atheihpih a; migilou in huai thei ding in theihsiamna anei kei hi.
english: The righteous care about justice for the poor. The wicked aren’t concerned about knowledge.

paite: Misimmoh hatte'n khopi ahal ua; himahleh mipilte'n thangpaihna aheimang uh.
english: Mockers stir up a city, but wise men turn away anger.

paite: Mipil in mihai akiselpihleh, aheh hiam anui hiam, khawlna a-om kei ding hi.
english: If a wise man goes to court with a foolish man, the fool rages or scoffs, and there is no peace.

paite: Sisan duh a dangtak in amah mihoihkim amudah; huan mitang ahihleh, ahinna azong uhi.
english: The bloodthirsty hate a man of integrity; and they seek the life of the upright.

paite: Mihai in ahehna tengteng agen a; himahleh mipil in agenkhe kei a, akhemdai hi.
english: A fool vents all of his anger, but a wise man brings himself under control.

paite: Vaihawmmi'n zuauthu angaih-khiakleh, asikha tengteng gilou ahi uh.
english: If a ruler listens to lies, all of his officials are wicked.

paite: Migenthei leh nuaisiah hat akituakkhawm ua; TOUPA'N anih tuak uh mitte asukvaksak hi.
english: The poor man and the oppressor have this in common: Yahweh gives sight to the eyes of both.

paite: Kumpipa ginomtak gentheite ngaihtuah, tangtawn in alaltutphah akip ding hi.
english: The king who fairly judges the poor, his throne shall be established forever.

paite: Chiang leh salhna in pilna apia; himahleh naupang ama thuthu a omsak in anu a ding in zumna ahi.
english: The rod of correction gives wisdom, but a child left to himself causes shame to his mother.

paite: Giloute apun chiang un, tatlekna apung hi; himahleh midiktat in apukna uh a-en ding hi.
english: When the wicked increase, sin increases; but the righteous will see their downfall.

paite: Na tapa bawlhoih in, awlna ahon pe ding hi; ahi, na kha a ding in nopna ahon pe ding hi.
english: Correct your son, and he will give you peace; yes, he will bring delight to your soul.

paite: Mengmuhna omlouhna ah, mite azautat uh; himahleh kuapeuh dan zui, ama'n nuam asa hi.
english: Where there is no revelation, the people cast off restraint; but one who keeps the law is blessed.

paite: Sikha thute a bawlhoih in a-om kei ding; thei mahleh alimsak kei ding.
english: A servant can’t be corrected by words. Though he understands, yet he will not respond.

paite: Athute a kinoh mi na mu hia? Amah sang in mihai a kipan in lametna a-om zaw hi.
english: Do you see a man who is hasty in his words? There is more hope for a fool than for him.

paite: Kuapeuh anaupan a kipan a asikha nuamtattak a kem in atawptawp in ama tapa hong hi in anei ding hi.
english: He who pampers his servant from youth will have him become a son in the end.

paite: Miheh in kinakna atokthou a, huan mithangpai in tatlekna ahau hi.
english: An angry man stirs up strife, and a wrathful man abounds in sin.

paite: Mihing kisaktheihna in amah alainiam ding; himahleh kuapeuh lungsim kiniamkhiak in pahtawina amu ding.
english: A man’s pride brings him low, but one of lowly spirit gains honor.

paite: Kuapeuh guta toh kithuah in amah kha amudah hi; nakpitak a ngetna aza a, huan bangmah agen kei hi.
english: Whoever is an accomplice of a thief is an enemy of his own soul. He takes an oath, but dares not testify.

paite: Mihing kihtakna in thang ahon tawi a; himahleh kuapeuh TOUPA a muanna koih abit ding hi.
english: The fear of man proves to be a snare, but whoever puts his trust in Yahweh is kept safe.

paite: Mi tampi'n vaihawmmi deihsakna azong ua; himahleh mihing vaihawmna TOUPA a kipan hong pai ahi.
english: Many seek the ruler’s favor, but a man’s justice comes from Yahweh.

paite: Midiklou midiktat a ding in kihhuai ahi; huan kuapeuh lampi a tang migilou a ding in kihhuai ahi.
english: A dishonest man detests the righteous, and the upright in their ways detest the wicked.
